7.6.1.3 Failed cycles
The counter Failed cycles is representing the number of operation cycles during which
the DTC fault detection counter reached its maximum value of +127 (since DTC infor-
mation was last cleared)
[SWS_Dem_00779]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04068, RS_Diag_04189, RS_Diag_04190
⌈If the counter ‘Failed cycles’ is mapped to an extended data record (DemInternal-
DataElement set to DEM_FAILED_CYCLES), it shall be available per ‘event related
data’ record.⌋
[SWS_Dem_00781]
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04105
⌈If the counter ’Failed cycles’ is already stored in event memory, it shall be incre-
mented at the end of the referenced operation cycle (refer to DemOperationCy-
cleRef) in case the UDS status bit 1 is set to 1.⌋
